diagnosis.reasoning: Arrival rate and prompt-token rate actually fell (-73%/-64%), so this is not a capacity problem driven by input load. The prefix cache hit rate collapsed from 0.86 to 0.48, which forces recomputation and fresh KV allocation per request, explaining the 460% jump in kv_cache_usage, the emergence of preemption (0 -> 2.25), and the resulting 572% growth in requests_waiting and queue time feeding TTFT. KV pressure, preemption, and queueing are downstream effects of the cache-efficacy regression, so they rank below it.
